title: Minimax Rates for Conditional Generative Learning under Wasserstein Loss
abstract: arXiv:2610.35490v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study minimax rates for conditional generative learning under integrated Wasserstein loss, with H\"older continuous conditional laws and an unrestricted covariate distribution. We evaluate unrestricted generators through their conditional output distributions. For expected Wasserstein loss, the minimax rate agrees with the rate under uniform covariates and follows from balancing localization bias against unconditional distribution estimation error. Higher moments of the loss can instead be dominated by unobserved covariate regions, which force an additional risk contribution of order $n^{-1}$, where $n$ is the sample size. An adaptive localization argument gives matching upper bounds. The results cover unrestricted response laws and possibly vanishing Besov densities for $W_1$, and extend to higher Wasserstein orders under uniform response density bounds and integrability conditions. translated_title: Wasserstein损失下条件生成学习的极小极大速率
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在积分Wasserstein损失下、具有Hölder连续条件分布和无约束协变量分布的条件生成学习的极小极大速率。我们通过条件输出分布来评估无约束的生成器。对于期望Wasserstein损失，其极小极大速率与均匀协变量情形下的速率一致，可通过平衡局部化偏差与无条件分布估计误差得到。而损失的高阶矩可能被未观测到的协变量区域所主导，这迫使产生一个阶为 $n^{-1}$ 的额外风险贡献，其中 $n$ 为样本量。自适应局部化论证给出了相匹配的上界。相关结果涵盖了无约束的响应分布以及 $W_1$ 情形下可能趋于消失的Besov密度，并在均匀响应密度界和可积性条件下可推广至更高阶的Wasserstein。多尺度下界证明闭合了对数间隙。
tldr: 该论文确立了具有Hölder连续条件分布和无约束协变量分布的条件生成学习在Wasserstein损失下的极小极大最优速率，证明期望损失的速率由局部化偏差与无条件分布估计误差的平衡决定，而损失的高阶矩会因未观测协变量区域产生额外的 $n^{-1}$ 阶风险贡献。
